first_principles_point: When big forms of control are expensive, small products can let people feel clean, prepared, attractive, generous, or competent.

proof_needed: category growth; volume; gross margin; advertising; promotions; inventory
safe_use: Safe claim: consumer goods can act as small control mechanisms, but this is a reading frame until company data supports it.
